notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Understand the agency, the workflow and the path to a conversation.
intro: A proposed account-development workbench for Concourse’s government software business, built around public institutions and their administrative workflows.
queueIntro: Public-sector buying context comes from agency structure, planning documents and procurement pathways. It should not be reduced to a generic company headcount score.
workbenchIntro: Prepare a sourced agency brief and a next discovery question. This is commercial research about software needs, not procurement advice or a purchase authorization.
firstBuild: An agency brief the AE can act on
firstBody: Connect a named operating unit and administrative workflow to a dated public planning signal, open procurement questions and coordinated sales ownership.

fields.label: Agency, jurisdiction and operating unit resolved
Budget or planning signal has a public source
Appropriate public business contact route identified

rules.title: Resolve the public institution
rules.next: A city, county and special district with similar names are distinct organizations. Preserve the agency key.

rules.title: Name the agency workflow
rules.next: Use a sourced permitting, grants, utilities or records workflow rather than generic government modernization language.

rules.title: Verify the planning signal
rules.next: Record the date, fiscal context and source. A budget line alone does not establish an available purchase.

rules.title: Clarify the procurement route
rules.next: Capture known procurement steps and unresolved questions for the account owner. Do not infer an exemption or authority to buy.

rules.title: Use the agency’s business contact route
rules.next: Identify the relevant office and its public professional contact channel. Avoid unrelated personal information.

rules.title: Coordinate the agency handoff
rules.next: Check current agency conversations and agree which AE and SDR own the next step.

ready.title: Ready for an agency discovery review
ready.next: The AE can review the workflow hypothesis, public sources and open procurement questions before deciding on the appropriate next conversation.

experiments.name: Workflow-specific agency research
experiments.hypothesis: A precise administrative workflow produces more relevant discovery.
experiments.primary: Held agency discovery per researched institution
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Coordinated agency coverage
experiments.hypothesis: One agreed account owner reduces overlapping outreach.
experiments.control: Separate AE and outsourced SDR lists
experiments.treatment: Shared agency key and next-action owner
experiments.guardrail: Duplicate contact and conflicting account ownership
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Define the agency research contract
roadmap.body: Map jurisdictions, operating units, public sources and ownership with the sales team.
roadmap.measure: Correct entity matching and source coverage

roadmap.title: Pilot one public-sector workflow
roadmap.body: Choose a permitting or grants segment. Build dated research briefs and coordinate AE/SDR follow-through.

roadmap.title: Expand repeatable coverage
roadmap.body: Add adjacent agencies only after validating the research and handoff process. Track source refresh and procurement unknowns.
roadmap.measure: Qualified agency pipeline and research maintenance effort

metricsTitle: Coverage is useful when the buying path is understood.
metricsIntro: Synthetic agency research distinguishes a sourced signal from qualified demand.
metricsNotes: Counts are illustrative and do not represent Concourse customers, government purchasing commitments or CJ’s outcomes.
A public budget or RFP is a research signal, not proof of an awarded contract.
The finance-AI company named Concourse is a separate employer with a separate portfolio.
